overview: This paper introduces SMART-R1, a multi-agent traffic simulation framework that employs an R1-style reinforcement fine-tuning paradigm with Metric-oriented Policy Optimization (MPO) and an iterative SFT-RFT-SFT training pipeline to align next-token prediction models with realism evaluation metrics.

modules.name: Data Tokenization & Preprocessing
modules.description: Preprocesses raw continuous agent trajectories and HD map polylines by applying the K-disks clustering algorithm to discretize continuous motions into a discrete motion token vocabulary and map tokens.

modules.name: Dataset & DataLoader Construction
modules.description: Constructs the dataset pipeline to handle tokenized agent histories and map contexts, managing multi-agent padding, masking, and batch sampling for efficient training and inference.

modules.name: Model Architecture - Token Embeddings
modules.description: Implements the embedding layers that convert discrete agent motion token indices and map token indices into continuous feature representations for the transformer backbone.

modules.name: Model Architecture - Transformer Backbone
modules.description: Builds the core autoregressive transformer architecture consisting of temporal self-attention layers for sequential dependencies, map-to-agent cross-attention layers for environmental context, and agent-to-agent self-attention layers for multi-agent interaction modeling.

modules.name: Open-Loop Behavior Cloning Pretraining
modules.description: Implements the foundational next-token prediction (NTP) training stage using standard cross-entropy loss to align the model's predicted token distributions with the ground-truth logged token sequences.

modules.name: Closed-Loop CAT-K Rollout Engine
modules.description: Implements the Closest Among Top-K (CAT-K) rollout strategy for closed-loop Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), which autoregressively samples multiple trajectories, identifies the trajectory closest to the ground truth, and constructs the SFT training targets.

modules.name: Reward Function Computation
modules.description: Calculates the scalar reward signal for reinforcement fine-tuning by implementing the WOSAC Realism Meta metric, aggregating kinematic, interactive, and map-based sub-metrics to score the quality of the simulated rollouts.

modules.name: Metric-oriented Policy Optimization (MPO)
modules.description: Implements the core RFT algorithm which computes the generalized advantage estimation based on the reward and an empirical threshold, calculates the unbiased per-token KL divergence between the policy and a frozen reference model, and optimizes the MPO loss function.

modules.name: Iterative SFT-RFT-SFT Pipeline Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the multi-stage R1-style training workflow, managing the sequential execution of the initial closed-loop SFT, the RFT phase using MPO, and the final closed-loop SFT phase, while handling model state transitions and checkpoint loading between stages.

modules.name: Evaluation & Benchmarking Engine
modules.description: Executes closed-loop simulation rollouts on the validation/test splits and computes the full suite of official WOSAC metrics (including minADE, collision rates, and off-road rates) to assess simulation realism and compare against baseline methods.

modules.name: Visualization & Qualitative Analysis
modules.description: Generates bird's-eye-view visualizations of simulated scenarios, overlaying ground-truth agent positions with solid simulated agent boxes across timesteps to qualitatively assess diverse driving styles and multi-agent interactions.

modules.name: Configuration & Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations for multi-stage training, handles logging and monitoring of metrics and rewards, and implements checkpoint persistence to save and load model states across the iterative post-training phases.
